headSubject: chore(ledger): close session -- REG-216/WMS-9 N4/WMS-11 fixed and verified
summary: Picked up all four residuals from the prior handoff (user chose 'all 4, best order'): fixed REG-226 (PasswordResetController's hardcoded identity_users table name -- turned out to affect the request-lookup step too, not just the confirm-bump step as originally filed), wired C6's candidatos procedure-bound dataSource into CrossDockingConsolePanel, built C7's cross-docking bay routing in AllocationCapability.sugerirOrigem/sugerirDestino (flows can't do listConcepts/mapList, had to delegate via callProcedure to their *Procedure twins), and root-caused+fixed REG-227 as two compounding kernel bugs in GeneratedCrudRuntimeSupport (JWT claims use 'sub' but the code only read 'actor_id', and a revoked token silently fell back to an anonymous-but-USER-roled context instead of rejecting). All four live-verified end-to-end against a rebuilt/rebooted wmsoffice at 127.0.0.1:8100. Filed two new gaps found along the way: REG-228 (a JWT app's signing keypair isn't in the regeneration-spared directories, hit and worked around three times this session) and REG-229 (run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 fails 7/882 tests deterministically on an unrelated Spring-context-bootstrap failure, not root-caused).
nextStep: Nothing from this session or the prior one is committed -- git status shows PasswordResetController.java, GeneratedCrudRuntimeSupport.java + its test, WMS-9.yml, and six REG-22x ledger items all modified/untracked, plus the still-uncommitted ChangePasswordController work from before. Review the diff and commit if satisfied (no commit was made this session -- not asked to). After that, two freshly-filed, unstarted gaps are open: REG-228 (small and already scoped -- two fix candidates listed in the item: add the key directory to the regeneration-spared list, or auto-provision a throwaway keypair on missing, the same way Build-NpdevApp.ps1 already handles a missing admin API key) and REG-229 (needs root-causing like REG-227 did -- the condensed gradle log never shows the actual missing-bean exception message; get it via a regenerated sample's preserved test-results XML or a full-stacktrace rerun). No single one is THE next step -- ask the user which to pick up, same as this session's own start.
blocked: Nothing externally blocked. REG-229's exact root cause (which Spring bean is missing) is unknown -- the gate's condensed console log never prints exception messages, only class names, and getting the real message needs a rerun that preserves test-results XML before the gate's own cleanup step deletes it.
verified: Kernel unit tests: gradlew -p NPDevKernel :adapters:runtime-support:test --tests GeneratedCrudRuntimeSupportKernelPortsTest -- BUILD SUCCESSFUL, all 7 tests pass (3 new for REG-227: stale-token-throws via actor_id claim, stale-token-throws via the real JWT sub claim, and a non-revoked regression check). PasswordResetControllerTest was NOT run as JUnit (same infra gap ChangePasswordControllerTest hit before it -- lives in the top-level NPDevRuntimeHost module, which needs the generated-runtime mount only run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 sets up). run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 run twice: both times BUILD FAILED with the identical 7/882 pre-existing failures now filed as REG-229, unrelated to this session's own edits (confirmed by grepping the deployed jar's bytecode for this session's own fix markers, both present). npdev_cli.py validate model: 0 errors, 58 pre-existing warnings, after every WmsOffice model.json edit. Live REST verification against a rebuilt+rebooted wmsoffice at 127.0.0.1:8100 for all four items: REG-226 (password-reset request completed cleanly, no table-not-found warning in the app log), C6 (GET the panel returns a real candidatos match), C7 (SugerirDestino/SugerirOrigem both route to the CrossDocking bay when active, normal ranking unchanged when not), REG-227 (stale token after a token_version bump: 200 before the fix, 401 after; a freshly minted token still gets 200).
